retained_finding: EconML is not justified as a WP507 core dependency at E1. Its strongest current value is concept distillation for aggregate statistical characterization after exact F2 per-run intervention/control receipts already exist: explicit treatment/outcome/covariate separation, held-out/cross-fit analysis, heterogeneous-effect characterization and uncertainty intervals.
causal_authority_fence: ECONML_ATE_OR_CATE_ESTIMATE != F2_OFFERED_DELIVERED_UPTAKEN_RECEIPT != PER_RUN_CAUSAL_INFLUENCE; statistical inference cannot mint canonical state, effect/completion authority or hidden-state/J-Space causality.
strongest_later_fit: F2-WP-507 optional aggregate analysis only after deterministic receipt closure
counterhypothesis: Noisy heterogeneous GWT experiments may eventually benefit from CATE/DML estimators beyond simple paired differences.
next_gate: Only under a separate future E2/E3/E4 claim, compare a simple F2-native paired estimator with a pinned EconML estimator on no-real-effect synthetic/replayed data with known heterogeneous effects and confounding; reject EconML if unique calibration/heterogeneity value does not outweigh dependency/provenance cost.
